To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
technology use during sleep is associated with sleep quality which is associated with depression and anxiety.
technology related sleep quality is a risk factor for depression/anxiety.
technology related sleep quality is a predictor of depression and anxiety, and that sleep quality mediates the relationship between technology related sleep quality and depression and anxiety.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of night time technology use on the psychological and sleep health of college students.
how the use of technology during sleep time may impact sleep quality and psychological health.
the relationship between technology use during sleep, sleep quality and psychological well-being.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the results of this study indicate that technology use during sleep can have a negative impact on sleep quality, which in turn can lead to increased depression and anxiety symptoms in college students.
the use of technology after the onset of the sleep cycle is associated with poorer sleep quality, which in turn is associated with higher levels of depression and anxiety.
technology use during sleep may have an effect on sleep quality and psychological health.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more time students spend on their phones after the onset of bed, the worse they sleep, and the worse they sleep the more likely they are to be depressed or anxious.
students who are more likely to engage in technology use during sleep are more likely to have lower sleep quality and higher levels of anxiety and depression.
college students who have difficulty with technology related sleep quality may be at increased for psychological health concerns.
The main takeaway from our work is that
college students are not getting enough sleep, and that sleep is important to psychological health.
technology use during the night may be an important contributor to sleep quality.
college students need to set boundaries around technology use.
